__comment: THE DISCHARGE END, so it wears the open mouth where the closed end wears a cap. A trommel is directional - fed at one end, discharging at the other - and with both ends identical nothing in the world told a player which block to park a chest against. Cell 3 is the outlet end (TrommelCoreBlock.outlet). The side texture sits on east AND west; only east is ever visible on this cell, west is against its neighbour.
